changes: watchPass retries each failed map phase on later passes, at most four attempts with a 20-second cooldown.
Cooldown starts when the preceding attempt finishes; mapAttempts records counts and start/end times.
mapErrors retains lists of error names and seconds since drop, including after success; unknown time stays null.
The final map phase requires a successful first phase and a complete witness.
drop waits for load, then two quiet seconds both before selecting files and after selecting files/case.
Each settle wait is a page_settle activity with quietMs, boundHit at 20 seconds and observer availability.
The Add click snapshots prePress counters and resets the frame clock; its timestamp survives navigation.
Earlier captures and their causes stay in prePress/prePressCauses, outside judged frame counts and smoothness.
Draining the click boundary does not introduce an empty judged capture. Kit drop README documents the rules.

inputs.real: Existing public test_only NYC GeoJSON and Tweed GeoPackage used by the unchanged offline suite.
inputs.controls: Synthetic late drawing, timeout, stopping/continuous long frames and pre-press attribution.

countOrder: Array checks contain exit code, passed tests, skipped tests; all failed counts are zero.
limits: No product code changed, runtime started, provider call made or protected data opened.
next: Lead review and an authorized live rehearsal; offline checks do not establish a new map/smoothness verdict.
